text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My meeting ran over, and now I'm late for
my training session with
Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I arrive at the training course to find
Taiki
standing alone, looking
utterly dejected.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wahhh! Traineeer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her tearful hug is akin to a crushing
tackle.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Sorry for breaking down on ya like
that, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I just can't handle flyin' solo. I get so
lonely that the tears start
flowing nonstop.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Everything was fine while all my friends
were here training and I had
people to talk
to...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But eventually, everybody else went
home, and I was left all on my
lonesome.
And you were nowhere to be found...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to tell since she's always
surrounded by friends, but it seems
she
gets lonely pretty easily.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sob... Oh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. Guess all that crying made me
hungry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To make up for missing her training
session, I decide to treat Taiki to
a meal.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ooh, a sit-down restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Look at all the food and drinks to choose
from! It's like I've died and
gone to
heaven!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Trainer,
you're as givin' as the day
is long!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did that not come across? Sorry!
I just
meant... you're really
generous!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What should I go with? Steak? A
hamburger? Or maybe the special
deluxe
parfait?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...On second thought, I'll take 'em all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I let Taiki keep ordering until her
stomach
is sufficiently satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...It's probably best not to dwell on how
light my wallet has become.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whew! Thank ya, Trainer! I'm so full—and
so happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But Japanese steaks are a little on the
small side...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The steaks I used to eat with my family
were twice—no, three times as
big!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That sure takes me back. I always loved
talkin' with my family and
friends over a
good meal.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I miss them all so much...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki hangs her head sadly. Considering
how easily she gets lonely,
the
homesickness must be particularly hard on
her.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thank ya! Thank ya very much!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going home yet! Not till I win the
Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My precious family and friends are rootin'
for me.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I love seeing their happy smiles every
time
I win!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Seeing everybody smile is my favorite
thing in the whole, wide world!
Nothin'
makes me happier!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So I won't let a little loneliness stop me
from giving it my all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
With you by my side, I can take on the
world!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We'll make everybody
happy—together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, with our spirits renewed, we set
our sights on victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, look! I see Dober over there!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, friend!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? What?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Dobeeer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wha—gyah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crash!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems we still have a lot of work to
do.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry! ☆
